dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's a diary doing hidden in the corner like this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It turns out that the huge stone slab outside is the one that Idyia gave to the painter as a canvas!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, it seems not only had he found landscapes he loved in the Veluriyam Mirage, but also made friends with Water Droplets and found some new inspirations for his paintings!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek! Now that you mention it, Paimon's heard of some people that go nuts after a failure! They just keep trying harder and harder until they lose themselves...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks to the painting tools Idyia provided and the company of the Water Droplets, he stayed on the right track!

choices.text: Better than practicing to the point of obsession...
